assumption_or_formula: Each dimension is rated from 1 to 5. The overall screening result is the arithmetic mean of entered ratings. The lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priorities.
evidence_note: Verify policies, governance records, metrics, audit evidence, stakeholder records and current reporting requirements.

assumption_or_formula: Diesel emissions (tCO₂e) = diesel litres × entered diesel factor (kgCO₂e/L) ÷ 1,000. Grid emissions (tCO₂e) = grid kWh × entered grid factor (kgCO₂e/kWh) ÷ 1,000. Total = diesel + grid. Intensity = total ÷ entered production units. Renewable share = renewable kWh ÷ (renewable kWh + grid kWh) × 100.
evidence_note: Verify fuel records, metered electricity, production data, reporting boundary and current emission factors.

assumption_or_formula: Potential diesel displacement = the lower of annual diesel use and solar generation × entered generator fuel rate. Fuel saving = displaced litres × fuel price. Avoided emissions = displaced litres × entered diesel factor ÷ 1,000. Simple payback = entered project CAPEX ÷ annual fuel saving when both are positive.
evidence_note: Verify solar resource, hourly load profile, generator performance, delivered fuel cost, project cost and current emission factors.

assumption_or_formula: The tool records influence, interest and relationship strength on a 1 to 5 scale, then uses those visible ratings to structure engagement priority.
evidence_note: Verify stakeholder identity, mandate, interests, influence, rights, current relationship and engagement history.

assumption_or_formula: Each institutional and execution risk is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall exposure screen. Highest-rated dimensions are surfaced first.
evidence_note: Verify current law, permit status, agency mandates, formal correspondence, policy documents and internal decision rights.

assumption_or_formula: The tool averages entered 1 to 5 ratings across trust, grievance response, local participation, commitments, communications and related dimensions. Lowest-rated areas are surfaced for follow-up.
evidence_note: Verify grievance data, commitments, engagement records, local employment and procurement evidence, environmental concerns and community feedback.

assumption_or_formula: The tool structures user-entered information into decision required, context, facts, unknowns, stakeholders, risks, options and next action.
evidence_note: Verify factual claims, decision authority, deadlines, stakeholders, risks and supporting documents before circulation.

assumption_or_formula: The tool combines a user-selected decision area with a fixed set of governance, evidence, downside, stakeholder and follow-up questions.
evidence_note: Verify the proposal, assumptions, downside case, decision rights, risk ownership and monitoring plan.

assumption_or_formula: The tool combines situation, action, evidence, verified outcome and lesson into an evidence-led achievement statement and interview structure.
evidence_note: Verify dates, role scope, metrics, documents, project records and attributable outcomes.

assumption_or_formula: The browser compares predefined professional themes appearing in both the job description and profile text, then surfaces matched and missing themes. It intentionally avoids a percentage fit score.
evidence_note: Verify role requirements, transferable experience, work authorization, language requirements and evidence for each claimed capability.

assumption_or_formula: The tool combines topic, audience, format and context with a fixed set of evidence, trade-off, stakeholder and action-oriented question patterns.
evidence_note: Verify event context, audience needs, current evidence, sensitive issues and any statistics used in responses.

assumption_or_formula: The tool searches a local index of public research titles and topic keywords in the browser and returns matching documents.
evidence_note: Review the source list, date and limitations inside each selected paper.

assumption_or_formula: The dashboard presents structured diligence questions and official starting points by sector rather than a single investment score.
evidence_note: Verify current requirements with official agencies, qualified advisers, contracts, project data and current legislation.

assumption_or_formula: The navigator matches user search terms to a curated list of public institutions and their broad administrative roles.
evidence_note: Verify current agency mandates, forms, fees, legislation, permit conditions and official contact channels.

assumption_or_formula: Each responsible-mining practice is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall screen and the lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priorities.
evidence_note: Verify environmental, safety, workforce, community, human-rights, procurement, closure, governance and compliance records.

assumption_or_formula: The library provides structured fields for recurring executive tasks such as issue escalation, stakeholder engagement, meeting preparation and action tracking.
evidence_note: Verify owners, dates, decision rights, source documents, commitments and closure evidence.

assumption_or_formula: End-use demand (m³/day) = people × litres per person per day ÷ 1,000 + process use. Required supply = end-use demand ÷ (1 − loss rate). Stress supply = required supply × (1 + surge rate). Storage = required supply × buffer days.
evidence_note: Verify demand records, seasonal variation, source yield, regulatory criteria, treatment requirements and emergency storage standards.

assumption_or_formula: Local procurement share = qualifying local procurement ÷ total procurement × 100. Local workforce share = qualifying local workers ÷ total workforce × 100. Target local spend = total procurement × target share. Shortfall = max(0, target local spend − current qualifying local spend).
evidence_note: Verify the applicable legal or policy definition, supplier classification, spend recognition, workforce eligibility and reporting period.

assumption_or_formula: Annual fuel cost = litres × delivered price per litre. Annual diesel emissions = litres × entered emission factor ÷ 1,000. Reduction litres = litres × reduction rate. Reduction cost = reduction litres × price. Reduction emissions = reduction litres × factor ÷ 1,000.
evidence_note: Verify fuel reconciliations, delivered price, operating days, production definition, reporting boundary and current emission factor.

assumption_or_formula: Indicative solar DC capacity = daily energy demand ÷ [peak-sun hours × (1 − loss rate)]. Average load = daily demand ÷ 24. Usable battery energy = average load × autonomy hours. Nominal battery energy = usable energy ÷ (usable depth of discharge × round-trip efficiency).
evidence_note: Verify measured load data, solar resource, equipment performance, operating philosophy, autonomy requirement and engineering design criteria.

assumption_or_formula: Priority score = community evidence × 25% + expected impact × 25% + urgency × 20% + reach × 15% + feasibility × 15%. Initiatives are sorted from highest to lowest score.
evidence_note: Verify community-defined needs, affected groups, expected outcomes, cost, delivery capacity, rights impacts and monitoring evidence.

assumption_or_formula: Screening score = (stakeholder importance + business impact) ÷ 2. Evidence confidence is reported separately to show where higher scores rely on weaker evidence.
evidence_note: Verify stakeholder evidence, impact assessments, financial analysis, reporting requirements and source confidence.

assumption_or_formula: The tool counts records, identifies open or unresolved records, calculates average entered days, counts severity 4 to 5 records and ranks grievance categories by frequency.
evidence_note: Verify case status, category coding, severity definition, closure evidence, confidentiality controls and safeguarding requirements.

assumption_or_formula: The tool structures a mandate, priorities, stakeholders, risks and available evidence into three phases: days 1 to 30, 31 to 60 and 61 to 100, followed by a day-100 review.
evidence_note: Verify mandate, decision rights, baseline metrics, stakeholder expectations, constraints, owners and review cadence.

assumption_or_formula: The tool structures agency context, meeting objective, verified facts, decision sought, sensitivities, commitment boundaries and follow-up into a disciplined meeting brief.
evidence_note: Verify agency mandate, official correspondence, current law, approved organisational position, delegated authority and commitments.

assumption_or_formula: Each procurement-control dimension is rated from 1 to 5. The arithmetic mean provides an overall self-assessment and the lowest-rated dimensions are surfaced as priority gaps.
evidence_note: Verify supplier due diligence, conflicts controls, tender records, contract clauses, environmental and human-rights expectations, approval trails and audit evidence.
